test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A scooter rider is travelling at a speed of 50 km/h. How much distance will he cover in 2 (1)/(2) {~h}?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the scooter rider = 50 km/h.

Time travelled = 2 (1)/(2) {~h}

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Time travelled = 2.5 hours

Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 50 km/h × 2.5 h

⇒ Distance = 125 km

**The correct answer is option 2.**
